workspace.hooks.editorHelp: An array of hooks: id, event, command (an argv), and optionally match, timeout_ms, sandbox, network, fail_closed, enabled.
workspace.hooks.help: Hooks are your own commands around the agent’s local tools and your local MCP servers’ tools (not its memory tools): before a call (they may refuse it, ask you, or change its input), after one (they may add a note), when you send a message, and when a turn ends. Each runs on this computer under the same sandbox as the agent’s commands, with no network unless you allow it. A repository’s .elitea/hooks.json is only a proposal: nothing runs from it unless you trust it, and it can never replace one of your own hooks.
